summary.en: The persistent frame of a narrated explainer: a chapter label with a yellow rule top left, one counter top right with its units, a "sorted by" label and a dashed illustrative note.
summary.zh: 解说片的常驻框架：左上带黄线的章节标签，右上一个带单位的计数器，“分法”标签和虚线示意注。

fits: Every scene of a film in the paper-ledger or sketch-paper look.
notFor: Films without chapters or a running count.

intent.en: Keep the viewer oriented: which chapter, how many so far, how the items were sorted, and that the data is illustrative.
intent.zh: 让观众不迷路：第几章、目前数到多少、按什么分的、数据是示意。

content.en: A chapter title (≤ 28 / 12), a counter value with a unit line (≤ 30 / 12), an optional "sorted by" line and a note.
content.zh: 章节名（≤ 28 / 12）、计数值与单位（≤ 30 / 12）、可选“分法”一行和注。

fits.zh: paper-ledger 或 sketch-paper 样式里的每个场景。

notFor.zh: 没有章节或连续计数的片子。

en: One counter a frame; when its meaning changes, blur it out and in with the new unit.
Every illustrative number gets the dashed note.
zh: 一帧只一个计数器；含义变了就模糊切换并换单位。
示意数字都要配虚线注。

overlaps.note: the keynote data frame with a progress rule and accent key; here the paper frame with one counter, units and the dashed note

waive.all: an own brick split from teach-video's terminal-ledger kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)
